frogs.Gerald: This is Gerald. He's a bullfrog. He doesn't know that yet.
frogs.Tuba: This is Tuba. He's the loudest thing on Gallatin, and he knows it.
frogs.Princess: This is Princess. She's a treefrog. She's never been in a tree. Don't bring it up.
frogs.Pickle: This is Pickle. Same as Princess, but Pickle.
frogs.Grandma: This is Grandma. She turns green when nobody's looking. Grandma, quit it.
frogs.Cheetah: This is Cheetah. She's a leopard frog. I named her wrong on purpose.
frogs.Freckles: This is Freckles. Count her spots. I got to twenty-six and she jumped.
frogs.Button: This is Button. He's no bigger than a quarter and he yells all night.
frogs.Marbles: This is Marbles. He sounds like marbles. That's not why I named him. It is, though.
frogs.Jellybean: This is Jellybean. He can jump thirty times longer than he is. I measured.
frogs.Banjo: This is Banjo. He only knows the one note.
frogs.Dumpling: This is Dumpling. He's a toad. Don't tell him.
